messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] problem importing PyStan in IPython
parts:
Hi Noah,

It looks like something went wrong during installation of PyStan. I
might try uninstalling PyStan (potentially evening rm -rf
/Users/noahsilbert/anaconda/lib/python2.7/site-packages/pystan) and then
reinstalling. Watch the installation output for any problems.

Best wishes,

Allen
